newsitem.title: USA: Dove Entertainment sees profitable Q4.
newsitem.headline: Dove Entertainment sees profitable Q4.

text.p: Dove Entertainment Inc said on Monday the company's fourth quarter ended December 31, 1996, is expected to be profitable.
The company said it has initiated expense reduction and restructuring programs that are expected to generate at least a 10 percent cost saving in 1997.
In addition, a restructuring plan will merge the book, audio and production departments, the company said.
All company operations will be consolidated in one building, generating further efficiencies, the company said.
These cost savings and the restructuring should improve the bottom line and create a more efficient company well positioned for profitable growth, the company said.
